0.a: {name} welcomes students from grades 3-12 who have an interest in robotics, STEM, and innovation. No prior experience is required for beginner courses.

1.q: What age groups do you serve?
1.a: We serve students aged 8-18 years old, with courses tailored to different age groups and skill levels. Our programs are designed to grow with students from elementary through high school.

2.q: Do I need any background knowledge?
2.a: No background knowledge is required for our beginner courses. We start from the basics and guide you through every step. For intermediate and advanced courses, we recommend completing prerequisite courses first.

3.a: Yes! Students who complete our courses receive certificates of completion. We also provide certificates for participation in competitions and special workshops.

whoWeAre.p1: Founded in 2022, {name} delivers engaging STEM education through real-world projects.
whoWeAre.p2: We help students turn curiosity into confidence, providing hands-on learning experiences that prepare them for future challenges in technology and engineering.

impact.title: Making a Difference
impact.successStoriesBody: Our students have gone on to win national robotics competitions, secure scholarships, and pursue careers in engineering and technology. Many have represented Bangladesh in international robotics olympiads.
impact.communityBody: We've partnered with schools across Dhaka to bring robotics education to underserved communities, organizing free workshops and providing resources to students who might not otherwise have access to STEM education.

howItWorks.title: How the Local Round Works
howItWorks.description: Compete in RoboFest Bangladesh 2026 through Robotics, Programming & Innovation Challenges with Top Performers getting closer to the World Stage.
howItWorks.step1Description: Students in Grades 05 – 12 compete under Explorer (Grades 05 – 08) or Innovators (Grades 09 – 12) and form a Team of up to 4 Members.
howItWorks.step2Description: Select from BottleSumo, Line-Following Bot, BuildAthon, or Robo-Exhibition, based on your Team's Interests & Skills.
howItWorks.step3Description: Compete in Dhaka or Chattogram under the Rules & Judging Format of your Selected Competition.
howItWorks.step4Description: Outstanding Teams may earn the opportunity to represent Bangladesh at the Robofest World Championship 2027 in Seoul, South Korea.

bottlesumo.name: BottleSumo
bottlesumo.description: Autonomous bottle-pushing: time trials, then head-to-head—no remotes.
bottlesumo.about: Push bottles off the table in a timed seed round, then fight head-to-head. Fully autonomous only.
bottlesumo.whoShouldJoin: Teams building and programming their own autonomous sumo-style robot.

highlights.2: Edge and object sensors required; 3-second start delay.
highlights.3: Win by pushing the opponent off and surviving on the table.

buildathon.name: BuildAthon
buildathon.description: Design, build, and present a robotics project under BuildAthon constraints.
buildathon.about: Build a working robotics prototype under theme and time pressure, then pitch it to judges.
buildathon.whoShouldJoin: Teams who want to invent and present an original robotics build.

highlights.1: Scored on engineering, creativity, and clarity.
highlights.2: Hardware, software, and storytelling all count.
highlights.3: No fixed arena game—your idea leads.

lineFollowingBot.name: Line Following Bot
lineFollowingBot.description: Race an autonomous bot along a marked line—accuracy and speed win.
lineFollowingBot.about: Program your robot to track a line course as fast and clean as possible. Sensors and control tuning decide the podium.
lineFollowingBot.whoShouldJoin: Teams who love autonomous control, tuning, and racing the clock.

highlights.0: Timed runs on a defined line path.
highlights.1: Focus on sensors, control loops, and calibration.
highlights.2: Beginners finish; advanced teams chase best times.

roboExhibition.name: Robo Exhibition
roboExhibition.description: Showcase an intelligent robotics project to judges and visitors.
roboExhibition.about: Bring any intelligent robotics project, demo it live, and explain the impact. Judged on innovation and presentation.
roboExhibition.whoShouldJoin: Teams with a distinctive project ready to show, not only race or fight.

highlights.0: Free theme within intelligent, autonomous robotics.
highlights.1: Live demo plus clear explanation to judges.
highlights.2: Scored on innovation, craft, and communication.
highlights.3: Ideal for research-style or long-horizon school projects.
